name: Team Rubicon
summary: Veteran-led volunteer crews clear debris, muck out flooded homes, tarp roofs and rebuild homes after disasters across the US.

spending.source: https://afd-e7wowbklhrmjo-anaaahfpavfhejfu.z01.azurefd.net/app/uploads/2025/11/FS-TeamRubicon-123124-Final-Signed.pdf (audited consolidated statement of functional expenses, year to 31 December 2024, p. 5: programme services $61,144,469 = Response $20,144,952 + Resilience $37,234,451 + Long Term Recovery $3,765,066, including $35.7 million of donated goods and services, $30.9 million of it advertising space in Resilience)

lines.label: Response: disaster response, recovery and mitigation operations and local service projects
lines.source: https://afd-e7wowbklhrmjo-anaaahfpavfhejfu.z01.azurefd.net/app/uploads/2025/11/FS-TeamRubicon-123124-Final-Signed.pdf (audited statement of functional expenses, 2024, p. 5): Response $20,144,952 ($19,286,372 in cash, Form 990 Part III). The response branch of the model.

lines.label: Resilience: training and recruiting volunteers (and donated advertising)
lines.source: https://afd-e7wowbklhrmjo-anaaahfpavfhejfu.z01.azurefd.net/app/uploads/2025/11/FS-TeamRubicon-123124-Final-Signed.pdf (audited statement of functional expenses, 2024, p. 5): Resilience $37,234,451, of which $30,888,271 donated advertising (note 10); $4,157,756 in cash (Form 990 Part III). Training is an input to the response work, so the model counts its cost with the response branch's result.

lines.label: Long-term recovery: rebuilding homes, workforce training and a grant to SBP
lines.source: https://afd-e7wowbklhrmjo-anaaahfpavfhejfu.z01.azurefd.net/app/uploads/2025/11/FS-TeamRubicon-123124-Final-Signed.pdf (audited statement of functional expenses, 2024, p. 5): Long Term Recovery $3,765,066, including a $1,000,000 grant to SBP (Form 990 Schedule I). The rebuild and SBP branches of the model.
